theorems.name: Submission.dohr_tv_tangentProj_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U U' : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (V' : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U') (ξ : Amb n ℓ), V'.carrier = (fun x => x - ξ) '' V.carrier → (∀ y, V'.mult y = V.mult (y + ξ)) → ∀ y, V'.tangentProj y = V.tangentProj (y + ξ)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
